subject: SIG packaging for procurement portal: split-packet vs consolidated PDF
messages:
From: Sally Huang <sally.huang@acmecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG export and upload requirements

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for moving quickly on the SIG. Our procurement portal (OneTrust) needs the package uploaded as a single consolidated PDF OR as a split packet where each evidence item is a separate PDF and accompanied by a manifest CSV. Two constraints to be aware of: a single file must be <= 100MB and the upload endpoint prefers PDF/A where possible.

Can you confirm you can deliver: 1) a consolidated PDF of the completed SIG answers + selected evidence, and 2) a per-control split packet with a CSV manifest (filename, checksum, control id)? We also need a screenshot showing KMS key policy and a pointer to audit log export for the period Jan-Jun 2026.

Our timeline: portal upload by EOD Aug 4 would keep our procurement cadence intact. Can you also include a DocuSign link or signature metadata for the SIG sign-off?

Thanks,
Sally Huang
Senior Procurement Manager
ACME Cloud

Attachment: procurement-specs-oneTrust.pdf (referenced)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sally Huang <sally.huang@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export and upload requirements

Hi Sally —

Appreciate the clear constraints. Plan below and questions where we need clarification:

Plan (deliverables by Aug 4 EOD PST):
- Consolidated PDF: SIG_answers-export.pdf (SIG responses + key evidence appended). We will flatten and embed fonts, produce PDF/A-1b.
- Split packet: individual PDFs per control (where evidence exists) + evidence_manifest.csv (columns: filename, sha256, control_id, description). We'll also include sig-split-index.txt for quick mapping.
- Screenshot: kms-screenshot-20260803.png (KMS key policy table).
- Signature metadata: we can supply a DocuSign envelope or a signed PDF; preference?

Questions:
1) If we produce both consolidated and split packets, do you want both uploaded to OneTrust or just the split packet?
2) For controls where evidence is internal-only (logs stored in our audit cluster), is a pointer to an S3 pre-signed URL acceptable in the manifest, or do you require an inline PDF export of the logs?

Internal notes (cc'd Marissa/ Mina/ Laura): Marissa — can you run the PDF flattening and produce PDF/A output and a concatenated consolidated file? Mina — please prepare the evidence_manifest.csv with sha256 checksums and note any artifacts that exceed 10MB so Marissa can split appropriately. Laura — procurement will need the PO number on the final upload entry; request that from ACME if they can share.

I'll stand up a short upload runbook once we confirm format and signature approach.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none yet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export and upload requirements — packaging notes

Jordan / team —

I can take the bundle work. A few operational points from recent marketplace uploads:

- One consolidated PDF is fine for the portal summary but many procurement teams (and Whistic) prefer split packets so reviewers can grab evidence per control. We'll produce both.
- Steps I'll run: normalize PDFs to PDF/A, flatten form fields, apply an upper-right stamp on each page with a short filename and checksum (visible but non-destructive), and generate the evidence_manifest.csv.
- For items over 100MB (we've seen large exported audit logs), we should provide an exported excerpt PDF and a pre-signed S3 link in the manifest. Mark those as "external_reference".
- Whistic metadata notes: they accept a JSON manifest; OneTrust wants CSV. We'll emit both: evidence_manifest.csv and evidence_manifest-whistic.json. If ACME asks for one format only, we'll upload CSV to OneTrust and attach JSON to the consolidated bundle.
- DocuSign: we can create a DocuSign envelope and embed envelope-id in the manifest. For a signed PDF, provide final-signed.pdf and a signature metadata file (signed_by, timestamp, envelope_id).

Mina — please flag any evidence that contains redacted customer data. I'll ensure redaction is applied before flattening.

I'll aim to push the artifacts to a secure share and then do a one-time upload to the OneTrust packet URL. If anything blocks (DocuSign delay, large logs), we escalate to Laura for procurement exception.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Delivery Operations

Attachment: packaging-checklist.txt

From: Sally Huang <sally.huang@acmecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export and upload requirements — ack and PO info

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clear plan. We will accept both the consolidated PDF and the split packet. A couple of notes from procurement: please include the PO number on the upload (PO-14902) and reference our HubSpot deal id: 8743. For any pre-signed S3 links, please set expiry to at least 14 days from upload.

DocuSign as envelope metadata is fine — we do not need the signed PDF inline as long as the envelope is accessible. Please proceed to upload to https://onetrust.example.com/portal/ACME/packets/9073 and notify this thread when complete.

Appreciate it —
Sally Huang
Senior Procurement Manager
ACME Cloud
